notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.content: Fixed another issue with crashing on some PCs. This one was rarer than the last, so it was much harder to find.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1 - It's like Patch 1.2.0 but without the crashing
notes.content:
Previously, we uploaded an update which:


 Added waaay more checkpoints. Like, 3 times more checkpoints.
 Added Background music
 Toggle button for said background music
 Title cards on each area
 Cool skellingtons and spires and stuff in the background
 Clouds
 Fixed Spanish (It was actually so insanely messed up I don't know how this went unnoticed for so long)
 and also added Brazilian Portuguese

But there was an issue where it would freeze or even crash on some PCs when changing music for the first time! Why? Because apparently some PC's don't like to load large audio files in real-time. So we made said audio files load in background instead. The issue is fixed now! Yay!!!!!

Im mandev and if you wanna join our discord servber you can join it here:

notes.title: v1.1.4 - Another small bugfix patch
notes.content:
Patch notes:

 Improved performance
 Fixed an issue where some PCs would lag every 30 seconds
 Fixed player limit not working always
 Fixed issue where pressing T would still open the chat box even when inside another input field
 Fixed a cheese with the giant ice slope
 Fixed a bug with the leaderboard with some instances of the player name being set to red
 Leaderboard should now display same timer as your actual runtimer
 Fixed several other small issues


Also thanks to UULaCrevette for letting me know about many of these issues and helping me playtest! Not only did he discover many of these bugs, but he compiled them into a Microsoft Word document for me. Very cool behaviour! There are still more to fix, but this is what we were able to get out today. 

If anyone has any more bugs to report or suggestions to give, let me know in the Manliest Discord server. Thanks for playing!

- ManliestDev

notes.title: Fixed leaderboard bug and wrong ending bug
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where sometimes the leaderboard would display a false score of 00:00:00
 Fixed a bug where new leaderboard scores would be uploaded as 00:46:00 instead of whatever they were meant to be
 Fixed a bug where clients would sometimes experience the wrong ending dialogue

notes.title: Added optional checkpoints!
notes.content:
You guys spoke and we listened. 

Everyone begged us for checkpoints and to make the game easier - so we added them to make the game easier. 

Normally I wouldn't do this, but I just looooooove my fans so damn much that I couldn't help it! That and the 25% refund rate, mostly from people complaining it was "too hard". Even though I thought this game had a pretty typical rage game difficulty curve (Barring certain other games I haven't played that you all for some reason think I've been trying to copy or something). So whatever. Enjoy your checkpoints!

Of course, there are some drawbacks though. 
Turning on checkpoints means you can't upload to the leaderboard, and you can't get the final hat and boulder skin. Also there is a Steam achievement just for beating the game without checkpoints, so there are still some rewards for those of you who prefer to play hardcore!

Also we fixed some bugs. 
Here are the patch notes:

 Added an optional checkpoint system.
 Removed a sawblade near the giant spinner. It was made to make the game possible for 1 person but apparently it's possible regardless. Thank you Crevette for proving that.
 Final slope can now be beat by 1 player.
 Fixed bug where dev screens would stay upon unpause and pause again.
 Undopplered some stuff.
 Vsync should save now.
 

As usual, enjoy. And feel free to join the Manliest Discord if you wanna chill with the dev/other players or you just have a bug to report, we respond there much faster.

Thanks.
-ManliestDev

notes.title: v1.03 - Another bugfix patch
notes.content:
Patch notes:

 Fixed a bug where some player's mics won't work
 Fixed leaderboard showing up too early upon beating the game and obscuring the end scene
 Fixed a bug where creating a new save with the same name as an old save would transfer the player positions of the old save
 Made a character's voice lines quieter
 Removed a level cheese
 Made boulder teleporter more visible from a distance
 Some other smaller issues


If you experience any new bugs, please be sure to let us know in the Manliest Discord, where we are most active.
Thank you all for your patience. We hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Another hotfix
notes.content: Looks like one of the bugs from the previous patch, where a player can't join or host a lobby wasn't actually fixed, but just made more rare. It should be fully fixed now. Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: v1.01 Fixed some major bugs!
notes.content:
Issues fixed:

 Players in certain regions would experience trouble joining and hosting games
 Certain PCs would crash upon trying to join or create a lobby
 Players would be extremely bright sometimes
 More than 4 players could join a lobby using the Steam invite button, wreaking havoc in the code 


Thanks for all your patience!
If you encounter any more bugs, please let us know in the Manliest Discord server.

notes.title: PUSHING IT! TOGETHER OUT NOW
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=_TcAvs5VzPA;full][/previewyoutube]


Get your friend group ready! Pushing It! Together is launches right NOW!

To celebrate, I've created a bundle with this game and the single-player predecessor, Pushing It! With Sisyphus!
And on top of that, I've also put both games on sale. Have fun!

The development of this game has been a tough and stressful journey. Not unlike the game itself! And poetically, the one game I made about teamwork happened to also be the the one game I couldn't make without the help of another developer. I'd like to thank Blind Archer, who handled nearly all of the online related stuff in this game. Couldn't have made it without him!

Anyways, that's my monologue. I hope you enjoy the game!

Oh, and if you encounter any bugs, please let me know in the Manliest Discord server, where I'm most active!

- Signed, The ManliestDev.
